mapper.insert: INSERT INTO twin_exp_record (user_id, user_name, exp_amount, source_type, access_type, room_id, room_name, create_time, anomaly_flag, anomaly_types, review_status, feed_source, session_duration_minutes) VALUES (#{userId}, #{userName}, #{expAmount}, #{sourceType}, #{accessType}, #{roomId}, #{roomName}, #{createTime}, #{anomalyFlag}, #{anomalyTypes}, #{reviewStatus}, #{feedSource}, #{sessionDurationMinutes})
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(exp_amount), 0) FROM twin_exp_record WHERE review_status != 2
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(exp_amount), 0) FROM twin_exp_record WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() AND review_status != 2
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM twin_exp_record WHERE review_status != 2
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM twin_exp_record WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() AND review_status != 2

SELECT r.user_id AS userId, COALESCE(p.name, r.user_name, r.user_id) AS userName, COALESCE(p.total_exp, 0) AS totalExp, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(r.create_time) = CURDATE() THEN r.exp_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS todayExp FROM twin_exp_record r LEFT JOIN aro_personnel p ON p.user_id = r.user_id WHERE r.review_status != 2 GROUP BY r.user_id, p.name, r.user_name, p.total_exp ORDER BY todayExp DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT r.id, r.user_id, COALESCE(p.name, r.user_name, r.user_id) AS user_name, r.exp_amount, r.source_type, r.access_type, r.room_id, COALESCE(rm.room_name, r.room_name, r.room_id) AS room_name, r.create_time FROM twin_exp_record r LEFT JOIN aro_personnel p ON p.user_id = r.user_id LEFT JOIN room_mapping_room rm ON rm.room_id = r.room_id
ORDER BY r.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM twin_exp_record r LEFT JOIN aro_personnel p ON p.user_id = r.user_id LEFT JOIN room_mapping_room rm ON rm.room_id = r.room_id

ORDER BY r.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
